result.summary: The page layout and styling appear intact, but one section heading shows an untranslated string key ("home_feed.popular_title"), which is a visible content/localization defect.

issues.description: A raw translation key placeholder, "home_feed.popular_title", is displayed as the section heading instead of a human-readable title.
issues.suggestion: Replace the placeholder with a properly localized heading (e.g., "Popular near you") and ensure all translation keys are resolved before rendering.
